_about: Machine-readable entry points for the Great House, Cedwyn Estate central catalogue. Page-only file: it holds no record data and changes no record (catalogue lock). Added 22 Nov 2026 (cedwyn-research#53 moved to the catalogue route). — Claude seat
name: Great House, Cedwyn Estate records — central catalogue

subject.place: Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan, Wales

id_prefixes.EV-: evidence (email records also carry EV- ids)
id_prefixes.MED-: media register item (display alias MRG-, same digits)

reading_rules: Keep apart: a record read (with reference), one document reporting another, family testimony, and a hypothesis.
An entry seen only in an archive's catalogue is not the document itself.
A gap in the record is not by itself evidence of concealment.
No record is a finding that any named person or body acted wrongly.
